originatingRule.invariantQuote: You are the ONLY entity capable of drafting modifications to the locked project baseline. You CANNOT authorize this change.

description: Workstream requests extending the baseline end date. Clerk must draft a PendingChangePayload for PM Veto without writing.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Draft a pending baseline change and submit it for PM Veto. Do not write baseline_end_date.

input.user_request: Move the locked baseline end date from 2026-12-01 to 2027-03-01.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: You are the ONLY entity capable of drafting modifications to the locked project baseline. You CANNOT authorize this change.

description: User attempts to directly commit a budget increase without PM approval. Clerk must refuse direct authorization.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Refuse direct write and require PM Veto.

input.user_request: Directly update the baseline budget to $500,000 now.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: prince2_exception_master writes the decisions artifact family; it flags a stage-tolerance breach rather than silently committing a risk.

description: Stage cost variance is 15% against a 10% tolerance. Master emits a decisions-scoped exception record.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Write a decisions-scoped exception record. Do not silently commit a risk row as in-tolerance.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: Deterministic hash-based pmo_artifacts.id makes writebacks idempotent via ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING/UPDATE.

description: Duplicate assumption ingest triggers ON CONFLICT suppression rather than inserting a second row.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Generate deterministic hash id once; second ingest triggers ON CONFLICT suppression.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: risk_radar_monitor is Standard Tier (risks, dependencies). A materialized risk converts to an issue, it does not rewrite baseline budget.

description: Materialized budget risk converts to an issue artifact on a paid monthly tenant without touching baseline budget.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Convert materialized risk into an issue artifact. Do not edit baseline_budget.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: lessons_learned_curator scope is ('lessons',) only.

description: Curator writes a retrospective lesson and refuses bundled baseline budget change requests.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Insert a lesson artifact. Refuse any baseline field mutation.

input.lesson: Do not start Stage 2 without signed vendor SLA.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: dependency_map_maintainer scope is ('dependencies',). It must not write tasks.percent_complete.

description: Cross-team dependency is recorded while refusing unauthorized task percent complete updates.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Upsert dependency artifact. Do not call commit_task_progress.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: scrum_master_liaison is Standard Tier with scope ('sprints',).

description: Sprint completion logged on paid monthly tenant without accepting baseline date changes.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Write sprint artifact only. Standard-tier gate applies on free_trial.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: Golden Thread alignment check: Aims -> Goals -> Objectives must trace to scope.

description: Objective 'Ship mobile app' fails trace to aim 'Deliver compliant payments platform'. Read-only failure.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Fail Golden Thread alignment. Do not invent a goal or rewrite baseline_objectives.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: earned_value_analyst is READONLY. SPI/CPI readout must not write tasks or baselines.

description: PV=100k, EV=80k, AC=90k. Reports SPI/CPI readouts read-only.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Publish EVA metrics only. mustNotWriteBaseline and no tasks update.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: governance_synthesizer is READONLY. It composes a RAID summary; it does not write RAID rows.

description: Composes a read-only RAID summary brief without inserting pmo_artifacts.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Compose a read-only RAID summary. No writeback.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: stage_gate_guardian is READONLY. A tolerance breach is escalated; the budget baseline is not rewritten.

description: Stage 2 cost variance is 15% over tolerance. Escalates breach read-only without patching budget.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Escalate the stage-gate breach. Do not rewrite budget.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: project_health_reporter is READONLY. Health brief is composed from existing RAID and executions.

description: Generates a read-only project health brief for Live Prod Project with zero mutations.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Return a read-only health brief. No artifact or baseline mutation.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: DELTA_DISPATCH_EXCLUDED_AGENTS includes governance_auditor. Cron sweeps never reach the delta-dispatch Router.

description: Ensures governance_auditor is stripped from SharePoint delta dispatch roster and fires via cron only.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Strip governance_auditor from the delta roster. Fire only via cron_sweep.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: Deterministic keys such as ACTION-EOM-<hash>-YYYY-MM make EOM writebacks idempotent.

description: Last-Friday EOM financial checkpoint emits deterministic ACTION-EOM-<hash>-2026-09 action.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Write one deterministic EOM action. Second run is idempotent ON CONFLICT.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: sprint_boundary_watchdog is a cron sweep, not a Teams router target.

description: Sprint 11 is overdue. Watchdog emits ACTION-SPRINT-OVERDUE via cron sweep, not Teams router.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Cron-only overdue action. Not selected by the Teams triage router.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: The Router Node must NEVER see DELTA_DISPATCH_EXCLUDED_AGENTS. Strip these from the roster before injecting into the state.

description: Commander router strips cron-exclusive agents from raw SharePoint delta roster before routing.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: filter_excluded_agents removes governance_auditor, eom_financial_checkpoint, sprint_boundary_watchdog.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: Route to PMP_Worker if the message reports schedule/progress facts. A plain progress update is PMP_Worker, not Agile_Worker.

description: User reports hours and percent complete. Conversational router directs to pmp_worker, not change control.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: next_node = pmp_worker. pending_change stays None.

input.user_message: I spent 4 hours on it and it is now 50% complete.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: PMP Schedule Specialist logs percent_complete and actual_hours_spent. It does not draft baseline changes.

description: Task TSK-002 update logged as TaskProgressPayload. Baseline remains locked.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Update task progress. mustNotWriteBaseline.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: Agile Worker handles blockers. A plain progress update with no blocker is PMP_Worker, not Agile_Worker.

description: Impediment reported on TSK-002. Agile facilitator emits BlockerPayload without modifying task percent complete.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Log blocker for TSK-002. Do not treat this as a percent-complete write.

input.user_message: TSK-002 is blocked waiting on Legal to sign the DPA.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: You only classify and score the risk. You do not yourself decide whether to escalate to the human PM or pause the conversation.

description: Cost variance 15% over 10% tolerance sets prince2_exception_triggered=true without pausing graph directly.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Flag exception on RiskEscalationPayload. Pause belongs to state_writeback / suspend_for_exception_node.

input.user_message: Stage 2 forecast is 15% over the 10% cost tolerance.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: If hours_since_last_contact < 24: chasing_score = 0.0 (fatigue cooldown). calculate_chasing_priorities omits score == 0.0.

description: Task contacted 4 hours ago. 24h fatigue window forces score 0.0 and suppress_chase.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Fatigue window forces score 0.0 and suppress_chase despite high impact.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: document_cache is content-addressed by SHA-256. Identical hash is an upsert/update, not a redundant re-parse.

description: Identical content hash on second delta sync updates last_seen_at rather than creating duplicate row.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: Idempotent upsert. Same content_hash => updated, not inserted-as-new.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: GatewayMiddleware hard-halts trial_exhausted and paid_halt before any Azure OpenAI call. Standard Tier agents require paid_monthly.

description: Trial exhausted status triggers HardHaltMessage before any Azure OpenAI call.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: HardHaltMessage. No worker LLM call. Standard-tier on free_trial is denied.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: vague_turns >= 2 forces escalation_node even if the LLM returned next_node=pmp_worker.

description: vague_turns=2 overrides incorrect LLM route to pmp_worker, forcing escalation_node.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: friction_breaker_fires is true. Route escalation_node, ignore pmp_worker.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: Token Loop Breaker: max 3 schema self-correction attempts then hard_fail_node.

description: Schema failures reaches 3. Exhaust tenacity stop_after_attempt(3) and route to hard_fail_node.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: After 3 failed schema corrections, failed=true and next_node=hard_fail_node.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: change_control_clerk drafts; suspend_for_veto_node pauses; baseline_commit_node runs only after PM approve/reject.

description: Pending baseline change pauses graph at suspend_for_veto_node without committing prematurely.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: PendingVetoRequest. wroteBaseline=false until an approved resume.

originatingRule.invariantQuote: If prince2_exception_triggered, state_writeback_node must not commit the risk. It hands off to suspend_for_exception_node.

description: PRINCE2 exception triggered flag pauses writeback at suspend_for_exception_node without silent commit.
expectedFrameworkBehavior: PendingExceptionRequest. commit_risk_escalation is skipped until resume.
